Class InMemoryRepository<ID,E>

java.lang.Object
repository.InMemoryRepository<ID,E>
Type Parameters:
ID - the identifier type
E - the entity type
All Implemented Interfaces:
Repository<ID,E>
Direct Known Subclasses:
AbstractFileRepository
public class InMemoryRepository<ID,E> extends Object implements Repository<ID,E>
Stores validated entities in a hash map in memory.
